summary: Approach lighting revised for runways 07 and 25 at EGVN, with no touchdown zone lighting.
text:
RWY 07 APPROACH LIGHTING CD5B 914M HIGH INTENSITY.
RWY 25 APPROACH LIGHTING CD5B 910M HIGH INTENSITY. 
RWY CENTRELINE LIGHTING WHITE/RED, HIGH INTENSITY, 30M SPACING. 
RWY EDGE LIGHTING COMBINED HIGH AND LOW INTENSITY FITTINGS, WHITE, 
50M HIGH INTENSITY AND 100M LOW INTENSITY SPACING. 
NO TOUCHDOWN ZONE LIGHTING.
PAPI RWY 07 3 DEG PORT 334M AND STARBOARD 347M FROM THRESHOLD.
PAPI RWY 25 3 DEG, PORT 330M AND STARBOARD 318M FROM THRESHOLD.
